Primary request: canonical adorable intern ox office cultivator. A chibi anthropomorphic ox, exactly 2.5 heads tall, broad soft ox ears, two short blunt ivory horns, warm grey-brown fur, rounded cream muzzle, expressive sleepy-but-amused eyes, human-shaped short body, rounded three-finger gloves. Modern rolled-sleeve off-white shirt over a loose cream tee, muted jade lanyard with blank paper badge, little canvas messenger bag, navy cropped trousers and round sneakers. Holds a chunky unbranded laptop closed under one arm and a wooden pencil like a tiny unawakened flying sword in the other hand. Friendly, quietly determined expression. Charming original design with a strong readable silhouette.
Style/medium: polished premium hand-painted 2D cartoon game illustration; crisp dark ink outlines, appealing flat-color shape design, restrained soft cel shading, subtle watercolor grain, beautiful professional mobile-game character art. Cozy Chinese fantasy meets contemporary office, playful rather than heroic warfare.
Composition: one single character only; full body, complete horns, ears, feet and props visible; three-quarter front view; centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas with 10% transparent padding all around; feet near 88% canvas height; same plane for both feet. No platform. Soft upper-left illumination.
Palette: warm rice-paper cream, deep ink navy, muted jade teal, antique gold in tiny details, gentle cinnabar accent; no neon.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no environment, no backdrop or ground plane, no drop shadow outside the character.
Text: none; blank ID badge.
Avoid: text, letters, digits, logos, watermarks, company marks, copyrighted characters, humans or human faces, horse face, armor, crown, busy magical aura, 3D plastic, extra limbs or fingers, cropped horns. Deliver usable sprite artwork, not a contact sheet or card mockup.
